legal.terms1Body: By accessing or using the NEW ERA platform, you fully agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must stop using the platform.
legal.terms2Body1: All materials, videos, tests and signals provided on the NEW ERA platform are created solely for educational and informational purposes. NEW ERA does not provide financial advisory or brokerage services.
legal.terms2Body2: Trading in the financial markets (Forex, cryptocurrency, securities) carries a high level of risk. The user bears full responsibility for any trading decision and its financial outcome.
legal.terms3Body: The user must provide accurate and truthful information when registering. Sharing your account login and password with third parties, and distributing or copying course materials without permission, are strictly prohibited.
legal.terms4Body: Access to paid courses is granted once the payment receipt is reviewed and approved. Each lesson unlocks in sequence after watching at least {watch}% of the previous one and passing its test with {pass}% or higher.
legal.privacy1Body: While you use the platform we securely store your name, email address, phone number, payment receipts, and learning-progress data (test scores, XP, watched lessons).
legal.privacy2Body: The data collected is used to provide the educational service, verify payments, issue certificates, keep accounts secure, and improve the user experience.
legal.privacy3Body: All personal data and payment receipts are stored in an encrypted database on secure servers (governed by Supabase RLS rules). Data is never shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
legal.refund1Body: The courses offered on the NEW ERA platform are digital information products. Once payment is confirmed and full access to the lessons is granted, the course materials are considered used.
legal.refund2Body: If payment was made but the user has not watched a single lesson or taken a single test, they may contact support within 24 hours of payment to cancel and request a refund.
legal.refund3Body: For any question about payments or refunds, reach our support team through the "Messages" section of your dashboard.
